nodes.label: Front matter
nodes.description: Material that precedes the main content, such as title page, table of contents, preface, copyright notices, and list of figures.

nodes.label: Summary
nodes.description: A condensed statement of the key points or findings, such as an executive summary or abstract.

nodes.label: Introduction
nodes.description: The opening section that states the purpose, context, and scope of the document.

nodes.label: Body
nodes.description: The substantive main content of the document that is neither introductory, concluding, nor back matter.

nodes.label: Conclusion
nodes.description: The closing section that wraps up the document with conclusions, recommendations, or next steps.

nodes.label: References
nodes.description: Bibliography, citations, footnotes, and links to sources used by the document.

nodes.label: Appendix
nodes.description: Supplementary material placed after the main content, such as extra data, tables, forms, and glossaries.
